main.title: Tour Highlights
items: Camping along the Umngot River, one of the cleanest rivers in India, is a unique experience
Enjoy the lush green nature surrounding you along the Umngot River
Indulge in various thrilling activities like Kayaking, Cliff Jumping, and Snorkelling.
Get cosy around a warm bonfire under a star-studded night and enjoy!

days.title: Day 1 : Arrival and Camping
items: You will be met by our representative upon your arrival in Shnongpdeng, where you will check into our campsite.
At the shore of the enchanting Shnongpdeng River, your tent would be ready. Take in the river breeze while resting in the tent.
As night falls, we'll set up a bonfire for you. Get some warmth from the outdoors and discover a different way of life outside of the hustle and bustle of the city life.
Savour your meal with loved ones while camping by the Dawki River and enjoying a bonfire outdoors. Go back to your tent later, rest and sleep soundly.

days.title: Day 2 : Adventure and Departure
items: The sound of the river and chirping birds will greet you as you awaken.
Take in and enjoy the fresh morning air. Without a doubt, the fresh air will refresh you.
We'll set up breakfast at the campsite.
Afterward, enjoy the thrilling activities included in your package after savouring your meal.
Following your departure, check out of the campsite.

items.text: Kayaking is an exciting water activity that involves maneuvering a kayak across the water. It differs from canyoning in terms of the paddler's seating position and the use of a double-bladed paddle. In Shnongpdeng, kayaking offers a thrilling adventure, with a 20-minute ride on an inflatable kayak becoming one of your most memorable experiences.
The cost for Kayaking is ₹500 per person.

Cliff Jumping is a thrilling adventure where you leap into the river wearing a life jacket, without the use of any additional equipment. This activity involves jumping from a hill or cliff ranging between 20 to 30 meters in height, offering an exhilarating experience.
The cost for Cliff Jumping is ₹500 per person.

Snorkelling allows you to glide along the water’s surface while using a diving mask and snorkel tube to explore the underwater world. In Dawki, this thrilling activity offers an unforgettable experience, especially for those with a passion for adventure. Without a doubt, snorkelling in Dawki, Shnongpdeng, is a fantastic choice for adventure enthusiasts.
The cost for Snorkelling is ₹500 per person.

Scuba Diving in Dawki, Shnongpdeng, offers a unique experience of exploring freshwater depths. Equipped with a self-contained underwater breathing apparatus, divers can breathe freely without depending on surface air supplies. The crystal-clear waters of the Dawki River provide a breathtaking underwater world, making it an ideal spot for beginners to enjoy a calm and immersive dive.
The cost for Scuba Diving is ₹3,200 per person.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions on Camping in Dawki, Shnongpdeng

items.question: 1. What is the lowest price for a riverside camping in Dawki, Shnongpdeng?

answer.text: The lowest and most affordable riverside camping package in Dawki, Shnongpdeng starts from ₹400 per person, which includes a tent and bedding.

items.question: 2. Are meals and breakfast provided at the Dawki, Shnongpdeng campsite?

answer.text: Yes, our camping package includes dinner and breakfast, which are served at the campsite. We also offer a budget-friendly package where you can pre-order your meals. We serve Asian-style meals, including rice, dal, potato fry, salad, and chutney. For breakfast, options include Maggi or bread with eggs.

items.question: 3. Do the camps provide bedding, blankets, and pillows for the Dawki tent stay?

answer.text: Yes, bedding, blankets, and pillows are provided as part of the riverside camping experience and are included in the Dawki tent package, priced at ₹400.

items.question: 4. Is there a bonfire or campfire arrangement at the campsite?

answer.text: Yes, a bonfire is arranged for guests who book the Camping Package or higher-tier packages.

items.question: 5. Is Dawki Shnongpdeng Camping a riverside camping or beach camping experience?

answer.text: Yes, it is a riverside camping that allows the visitors to completely indulge in the natural beauty of crystal clear Umngot River while enjoying the amazing experience of camping.

items.question: 6. Are lights provided inside the tents during camping at Dawki River?

answer.text: Yes, rechargeable lights are provided inside the tents for overnight camping in Dawki, Shnongpdeng.

items.question: 7. Is parking available at the campsite?

answer.text: Yes, parking space is available outside the Dawki, Shnongpdeng Campsite payable directly to the parking authorities for both two-wheelers and four-wheelers.

items.question: 8. Are luggage storage facilities available during the Dawki tent stay?

answer.text: Luggage can be kept inside the tents. However, for valuable items, you can store them with the campsite owner for safekeeping.

items.question: 9. Is private camping available in Dawki, Shnongpdeng?

answer.text: Yes, private camping is available at ₹1,500 per tent. The camping takes place in a secluded riverside location with spacious alpine tents.

items.question: 10. What are some nearby attractions to explore while Camping in Dawki, Shnongpdeng?

answer.text: Umngot River:
This crystal-clear river is ideal for performing thrilling activities or just relaxing.
Bangladesh Border Viewpoint
: Witness the view of the International Border here.
Jaflong Zero Point:
This point gives enchanting views of transparent Umngot River.
Living Root Bridges
: These bridges can be visited via a short trek from nearby villages.
Mawlynnong Village:
This mesmerising village also known as ‘The Cleanest Village of Asia’ can be visited after a short drive.

items.question: 11. Can I charge my phone at the campsite?

answer.text: Host can provide a charger and would help you charge your phone whenever needed.

items.question: 12. How can one reach Dawki Shnongpdeng?

answer.text: There are various modes to reach this destination:
By Air:
-Nearest Airport: Umroi Airport (119.5 km) -Major Airport: Lokpriya Gopinath Bordoloi International Airport (228.1 km)
By Train:
-Nearest major station: Guwahati Railway Station (206 km)
By Road:
-From Shillong: It would take around 2.5–3 hours via taxi or shared vehicle. -From Guwahati: It would take around 5–6 hours via car or bus.
From Dawki to Shnongpdeng:
-Dawki to Shnongpdeng is just 7.4 km apart. You can take a shared ride or a cab.

items.question: 13. What is the best time for camping in Shnongpdeng, Dawki River?

answer.text: The best time for camping in Shnongpdeng, Dawki River is from October to March. However, camping can be enjoyed during other months too.

items.question: 14. Are the camping tents in Dawki waterproof?

answer.text: Dawki Tents are indeed waterproof and there is no need to worry if there is a sudden rainfall during overnight camping.

items.question: 15. Can Camping in Dawki, Shnongpdeng be done during monsoon or rainfall?

answer.text: Yes, Camping in Dawki, Shnongpdeng can be done during monsoon but during heavy rainfall tents are generally shifted to another camping site which is at a higher ground level for safety purpose.

items.question: 16. What are the adventure activities that can be undertaken with Camping in Dawki, Shnongpdeng?

answer.text: The adventure activities that can be enjoyed with Camping in Dawki, Shnongpdeng are Kayaking, Snorkeling, Scuba Diving and Cliff Jumping.
